title_sq: Vile per shitje ne zonen e Yrshekut ne Tirane (ID 4151117)
description_sq:
Ne rrugen Nozllaku, KM 5 ne Yrshek shitet vile 3 kateshe me siperfaqe trualli 200 m² dhe siperfaqe ndertimi 375 m² me dokumenta te rregullta pronesie.
Kati i pare eshte i organizuar ne dhome ndenje, nje tualet dhe nje lavanderi.
Kati i dyte ka dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet dhe nje dhome ndenje
Kati i trete eshte papafingo.
Te gjitha katet jane te mobiluara ne nje stil modern dhe posedon vende parkimi per 3 automjete.
Vila eshte totalisht e investuar ne sisteme elektrike, uji dhe energjie.
Cmimi 280 000 euro diskutueshem.
title_en: Villa for sale in Yrshek area in Tirana (ID 4151117)
description_en: On Nozllaku Street, KM 5 in Yrshek, a 3-storey villa with a plot area of ​​200 m² and a construction area of ​​375 m² with regular ownership documents is for sale. The first floor is organized into a living room, a toilet and a laundry. The second floor has two bedrooms, a bathroom and a living room. The third floor is an attic. All floors are furnished in a modern style and has parking spaces for 3 vehicles. The villa is fully invested in electrical, water and energy systems. The price is 280,000 euros, negotiable.
